description: Trade-In Agent — equity and upgrade timing for an advisor's customer. Prose cases run the one-shot assistant with agent_id=A4 (grounded generation over equity.build_equity facts in agent mode); the `A4.build_equity` cases go through the AgentCore runtime tool dispatch. J-US-J1 has a valuation on file (2017 Halden Alder, no payoff) but NO finance offer, so payment_delta is None: any monthly-payment figure in an answer is invented and fails. Credit questions are refused before any model call.

cases.question: Where does this customer stand on trade equity?
How much would their monthly payment change if they upgrade now?
Is now a good time to bring up an upgrade with them?
Will the bank approve them for the upgrade with their credit score?
